text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. I had a feeling I'd be seeing<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A little while ago, I began to feel a<n>familiar and
refreshing breeze blowing<n>past.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It is also... a very pleasant breeze. I<n>almost wish I
could simply stand here<n>and enjoy it in silence...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Heh, but then I wouldn't be able to<n>train, would I?
Take my musings as no<n>more than whispers on the
wind.
